value.rationale: The natural cube/cross-polytope Cayley hull is a current bipolar-polytope realization. Its affine-invariant Mahler product requires the optimal Santaló shift, rather than the already known origin-polar volume. The exact strictly increasing drift and universal e²/4 normalized limit quantify a structural geometric transition across every dimension, providing a nontrivial benchmark for asymmetric layered convex polytopes without claiming a general Mahler inequality.
